pa-example-rules.txt: PA topic coding examples: (1) County Code authority allowing county appropriations to municipal corporations for disaster/emergency aid is local government and governance (2401). (2) A legislative resolution requesting DEP reporting on environmental statute violations, enforcement actions, and department accounts funded by environmental fines/penalties is environment (700), even though it mentions agency accounts and reporting. (3) A recognition resolution for a professional concert band is arts/culture (609). (4) Public School Code changes to Commonwealth reimbursement for vocational-technical programs are vocational education (604), even when the bill also makes an appropriation. General application: classify by the substantive policy being addressed; incidental appropriations, reporting, or recognition language need not determine the topic. Do not extend these examples beyond their described subjects without checking the codebook.
